snippet.title: Google Design
snippet.description:
Google Design is a cooperative effort led by a group of designers, writers, and developers at Google. We work across teams to create content and produce events that showcase Google’s design work and champion innovators in our field.

Learn more about Google's design guidelines, assets, resources, events and job opportunities at design.google

Follow Google Design on
Twitter: https://twitter.com/googledesign
Instagram: https://instagram.com/googledesign
Medium: https://medium.com/google-design
